## 1. Executive Summary & Identity

- **Full Name:** Zasim Mallik
- **Title:** Software Engineer | Founder of Zeraql & Rizmiq
- **Location:** Natullabad, Barisal, Bangladesh
- **Canonical URL:** https://zasimmallik.com/
- **Contact Email:** zasimmallickofficial@gmail.com
- **Availability:** Selective opportunities, AI SaaS collaborations, and full-stack software engineering projects.

### Biography

I'm Zasim Mallik, a self-taught software engineer from Bangladesh. What started as a curiosity for how the web works quickly evolved into a passion for architecting and shipping full-scale products that people rely on.

Today, I lead product and engineering for **Zeraql** and **Rizmiq**, two AI-powered SaaS platforms I'm building end to end. Working primarily with **Next.js**, **TypeScript**, and **Python**, I focus on making sophisticated backend and AI systems feel effortless on the surface.

I believe the best way to master engineering is by shipping real software. Every architecture decision, edge case, and late-night debugging session has shaped how I build, keeping me pragmatic, detail-oriented, and focused on real-world impact.

### Engineering Philosophy

> "Time is the most precious resource we have. We build software to save it, making things work faster, simplifying everyday tasks, and making the world a better place." - Zasim Mallik
